notes.title: NEW CAREER MODE
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43952165/203e710235cd6ba9997154d82a379b222c5835fb.png

CONTENT

New Career mode and tournaments

**Fix Note:**

 Introduced a new "Career" section with several exciting tournaments to participate in.
 Added two new types of batteries: 1s and 6s, as well as one type of motor to expand player possibilities.
 Updated spare parts parameters for a more balanced gameplay.
 Fixed the calculation of Car Upgrade Points for a more accurate progress assessment.
 Added new tournaments for a diverse gaming experience.
 Implemented two tracks: "Over The City" in the Suburban location and "Blue Roof Castle" in the Miniatures location.
 Optimized and fixed existing tracks, ensuring smoother and more satisfying gameplay.
 Players can now change the CPU (ESC) for aerial stabilization, considering that it may interfere with performing tricks.
 
 Added the ability to change SPUR for fine-tuning Gear Ratio and a more flexible control approach.
 Addressed pause functionality, test track issues, and ensured accurate path display.
 Resolved off-road bot behavior and implemented various minor fixes for improved performance.
  Start speed improved

notes.title: Dev update: Join the 'Points of Interest' event and claim victory! + fixes
notes.content:
Unleash the excitement: Introducing the spectacular "Points of Interest" event!
Revamped pause interface: Enhancing your gameplay experience!
Interface perfected: Smooth sailing ahead!
Geometry refined: Navigating with precision!
Performance optimization: Unleashing maximum speed!


New mode: "Points of Interest"

Immerse yourself in the thrill of the hunt as you embark on an adventure to discover 5 hidden "Points of Interest." Keep your eyes peeled for the tantalizing question marks on the mini-map and the captivating animated question marks scattered across the location. Feel the rush as you speed towards each mysterious location, collecting them one by one.

But here's the twist: the clock is ticking! With each event launch, a countdown timer sets the stage for an adrenaline-fueled race against time. The quest resets every time you restart, pushing you to explore the corners of the map once again.

Complete the challenge, and your triumph will be etched in the annals of the event leaderboard. The top 3 contenders will be rewarded handsomely for their unmatched skills and dedication.

Prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. The "Points of Interest" event awaits, where speed, precision, and a keen eye are the keys to victory. Get ready to leave your mark and claim your well-deserved place among the elite!

notes.title: Rev up your engines: unveiling cars and customization in RC REVOLuTion!
notes.content:
One of the questions we've been receiving is:

New cars? Any chance there are going to be new cars or new ways to change up how the cars look?

Well, buckle up, because we're about to delve into the fantastic world of RC car customization and new additions!

Two Leagues, Two Experiences

Our game features two leagues that cater to different types of players.

Amateur League: For those who just want to hop in and race without any fuss. This league features non-disassemblable cars in boxes, using arcade physics. It's all about straightforward fun and speed. The current demo on Steam offers a taste of the Amateur League, and we're working on adding the ability to change the cars' paint jobs.

Professional League: This is where things get really interesting. The cars in this league consist of separate modules, built upon one of four main bases. The customization possibilities here are almost endless!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/bca244c2d53530c0ef60a913ad20f65587ee3e14.png

Details Make the Difference

We're making an exciting, arcade-style racing game, but we want it to have depth, too. We're looking at real RC cars and understanding how they work, right down to the smallest gear. This allows us to create an immersive experience that RC fans will find intriguing and satisfying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/0b1960938b07e83f5744f3f0fe5092d88150c763.png

Of course, we're not trying to make a hyper-realistic simulator—that's not our goal. We want to keep the game fun and diverse, which means accepting certain game conventions and balancing realism with playability.

A Deeper Look at the Pro League Customization

In the Pro League, customization is king. We're considering how different parts will fit together, allowing players to truly create the car of their dreams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/71beae1f811cbcc64ec3714eb286a8bba39311a7.png

For instance, look at this RC type BUGGY base. When we tried fitting a battery model, we realized that only the simplest and cheapest battery fits into this variant. This means we need to modify the layout of parts or the shape of the base itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/3eb08742771d7d723588aeb6440506e2c7f9dc43.png

Experimentation is part of the process. We're constantly trying out new external cases and models, always aiming for diversity.

Customization UI and More

Finally, take a look at our UI prototype for customization. Soon, you'll have the chance to try changing skins for the cars in our demo, taking personalization to a whole new level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952165/268de6ff6c0bf88babb592c712be448a5debe3a2.png

This is just a brief overview in response to your questions from the Steam community. We're always eager to share more about our development process and future plans, so don't hesitate to ask more questions. We'll do our best to answer them as fully as possible.

Stay tuned for more updates and keep those engines revving!

notes.title: 16 Jun 2023 Patch notes
notes.content:
Get ready, racers, we've got a fresh batch of updates that will make your engines purr!


Calling all beach goers and sun seekers! We've just added a new location: The glorious, sun-kissed Coast. Don't forget to wear sunscreen!


The Suburban location has a new neighbor: the second track, Backyard. Be careful not to disturb the BBQ!


Coast location just got a double dose of excitement. Two new tracks have been added. Are you ready to make some waves?


We're taking technicality to a new level! Now you can handpick your battleground with our new interface for selecting locations and tracks. It won't make your car faster, but it sure does look snazzy!


Check out our shiny new racing interface! It's slicker than a greased-up gearbox.


Our mini-map decided it was time for a career change. It's now working in navigator mode. Because who needs a map when you can have a personal GPS?


Remember, racing might be a serious business, but don't forget to enjoy the ride! Start your engines, and let's hit those new tracks.
